plugins.name: shiny-client
plugins.description: Cross-platform mobile framework — BLE, GPS, geofencing, jobs, notifications, push, HTTP transfers, OBD, music, and more for .NET MAUI, iOS, and Android

plugins.name: shiny-maui
plugins.description: Purpose-built .NET MAUI components — Shell navigation with source-generated routes, scheduler/calendar views, TableView settings pages, contact store access, and Mermaid diagram rendering

plugins.name: shiny-mediator
plugins.description: Mediator/CQRS pattern for .NET — request/response, commands, events, streams, middleware, HTTP client generation, and project scaffolding

plugins.name: shiny-data
plugins.description: Lightweight AOT-compatible data libraries — DocumentDB JSON document store and Spatial geospatial database with R*Tree indexing

plugins.name: shiny-aspire
plugins.description: Shiny .NET Aspire integrations — Orleans ADO.NET hosting and Gluetun VPN container routing

plugins.name: shiny-extensions
plugins.description: Source generators and utilities — DI registration, key/value stores, reflection, localization, MAUI hosting modules, and ASP.NET Core web hosting modules
